words.example: The pain is acute and new.
words.exampleZh: 疼痛是急性的，而且才剛開始。
words.notes: acute infection 是急性感染。也可指敏銳的。

words.example: The ambulance is already downstairs.
words.notes: 可數。call for an ambulance 是叫救護車。

words.example: The family is anxious in the hall.
words.notes: anxious about 是為某事焦慮。very 可修飾。

words.example: His lips look ashen.
words.notes: ashen face 是蒼白的臉色。looking ashen 是面色鐵青。

words.example: The casebook is missing from the folder.
words.exampleZh: 資料夾裡的病歷不見了。
words.notes: paper casebook 是紙本病歷。

words.example: The clinic opens at eight.
words.notes: fracture clinic 是骨科門診。throat clinic 是喉科門診。

words.example: The clinical note is brief.
words.notes: clinical trial 是臨床試驗。也可指客觀的。

words.example: Cupping left round marks on the back.
words.notes: cupping therapy 是拔罐療法。

words.example: The patient was dead on arrival.
words.notes: 作表語表示已經死亡。

words.example: The death was recorded at dawn.
words.notes: 複數 deaths 指死亡人數。

words.example: Age brings a slow debility.
words.notes: breakdown 與 weakness 近義。

words.example: The notice listed the decease as sudden.
words.exampleZh: 通知上寫這次亡故來得突然。
words.notes: decease of disease 是病歿。作動詞是死亡。

words.example: They diagnose the rash as an allergy.
words.exampleZh: 他們把疹子診斷為過敏。
words.notes: be diagnosed with 是被診斷患有。

words.example: People can die of this infection.
words.notes: die of 多指死於疾病。die from 多指死於外因。也可指消亡。

words.example: The ward will discharge her tomorrow.
words.notes: 也可表示免除。作名詞時是出院許可。

words.example: The forecast for recovery looked dismal.
words.exampleZh: 復原的預期看起來很陰鬱。
words.notes: gloomy 近義。depressing 是令人壓抑的。

words.example: He hopes to donate a kidney.
words.notes: donate to 是捐給。作名詞是捐贈。

words.example: The night in pain was dreadful.
words.notes: terrible 與 horrible 近義。

words.example: Staff efficiency dropped after midnight.
words.notes: 不可數。efficiency 作主語時動詞用單數。

words.example: An efficient handoff saves time.
words.exampleZh: 有效率的交班能省時間。
words.notes: be efficient in 是在某方面有效率。也可指有能力的。

words.example: Call if this becomes an emergency.
words.exampleZh: 如果變成緊急狀況就打電話。
words.notes: emergency room 是急診室。emergency treatment 是緊急處置。

words.example: Light exercise starts next week.
words.notes: 也可指體操或練習。作動詞是運動。

words.example: Long shifts exhaust the night team.
words.exampleZh: 長班把夜班團隊耗盡了。
words.notes: 也可指把人累垮，或指排氣。

words.example: The review was exhaustive.
words.notes: exhaustive study 是徹底的研究。exhaustion gap 是竭盡缺口。

words.example: She spoke faintly.
words.notes: feebly 與 weakly 近義。

words.example: The heat made him fainty.
words.notes: 若感到 fainty，應去檢查。

words.example: The fear of needles is common.
words.notes: fear of 是對某事的恐懼。作動詞是害怕。

words.example: The health check is yearly.
words.notes: be good for the health 是有益健康。也可指衛生。

words.example: The baby is healthy.
words.notes: healthy body 是健康的身體。也可修飾食物。

words.example: They waited hopefully for the result.
words.notes: hopeless 是絕望的。hopelessly 是絕望地。

words.example: The hospital has a night desk.
words.notes: in hospital 常指住院。in the hospital 常指人在醫院這棟建築裡。

words.example: The hospitalization lasted four days.
words.notes: hospitalization insurance 是醫療保險。hospitalization process 是住院流程。

words.example: They may hospitalize the child tonight.
words.exampleZh: 他們今晚可能讓孩子住院。
words.notes: hospitalize in 是安排在某醫院住院。

words.example: She asked them not to hypnotize her brother.
words.exampleZh: 她要求他們不要對她弟弟施催眠術。
words.notes: 也可指使著迷。可直接接人或代詞。

words.example: The monitor is inanimate equipment.
words.exampleZh: 監視器是無生命的設備。
words.notes: dead 與 lifeless 近義。

words.example: Indoor walks are allowed.
words.notes: indoor sports 是室內運動。indoor photography 是室內攝影。

words.example: The infant sleeps in the nursery.
words.notes: infant mortality 是嬰兒死亡率。作形容詞是嬰兒的、幼稚的。

words.example: The school infirmary sent him here.
words.exampleZh: 學校醫務室把他轉來這裡。
words.notes: 也可指小型醫院。

words.example: The inpatient eats breakfast in bed.
words.exampleZh: 這位住院病人在床上吃早餐。
words.notes: inpatient expenditure 是住院費用。

words.example: Gowns help insulate staff from splashes.
words.exampleZh: 隔離衣有助於讓人員避開噴濺。
words.notes: insulate from 是使不受某物影響。be insulated by 是被某物隔開。

words.example: He was mad with pain and could not lie still.
words.notes: 也可指著迷的。作名詞是狂怒。

words.example: A light massage eased the neck.
words.notes: foot massage 是足部按摩。massage chair 是按摩椅。

words.example: The mortality for this procedure is low.
words.exampleZh: 這個處置的死亡率很低。
words.notes: mortal 是致死的。mortally 是致命地。

words.example: The muscle is sore after the stairs.
words.notes: pull a muscle 是拉傷肌肉。也可指力量。

words.example: A myriad of forms covers the desk.
words.notes: countless 與 infinite 近義。作形容詞是無數的。

words.example: One risk remains, namely infection.
words.exampleZh: 還有一個風險，亦即感染。
words.notes: 用來點出前面說過的事物。一般位於句中。

words.example: The arm is numb after the block.
words.notes: numb to 是對某事麻木。也可作動詞，表示使麻木。

words.example: Numerous visitors waited downstairs.
words.notes: numerous patients 是大量病人。

words.example: The nurse checked the drip.
words.notes: head nurse 是護理長。作動詞是看護。

words.example: The nursery is quiet after nine.
words.notes: nursery school 是幼兒園。nursery tales 是童話。

words.example: Nursing continues through the night.
words.notes: nursing care 是護理照護。nursing staff 是護理人員。

words.example: Please obey the fluid limit.
words.notes: obey the rule 是遵守規定。少用於被動。

words.example: There is an obligation to report the fall.
words.exampleZh: 跌倒必須呈報，這是義務。
words.notes: fulfill an obligation 是履行義務。undertake an obligation 是承擔義務。

words.example: The safety class is obligatory.
words.notes: obligatory course 是必修課程。obligatory right 是義務性權利。

words.example: The outpatient returns on Friday.
words.exampleZh: 這位門診病人星期五回來。
words.notes: outpatient clinic 是門診所。outpatient department 是門診部。

words.example: The bill felt outrageous.
words.notes: bearish 是粗暴的。abhorrent 是可惡的。

words.example: The benefit can outweigh the risk.
words.notes: 後接名詞或代詞。兩者不必完全同類，但要能比較。

words.example: I did not mean to overhear the result.
words.notes: 過去式 overheard 不規則。除了 that 子句，也可接名詞。

words.example: The child looks pale.
words.notes: look pale 是臉色蒼白。very 與 extremely 可修飾。也可指無力的。

words.example: Nurses palpate the tender spot first.
words.exampleZh: 護理人員先觸診壓痛的位置。
words.notes: palpate sth with sth 是用某物觸診。

words.example: The wait will test your patience.
words.exampleZh: 這段等待會考驗你的耐心。
words.notes: patience towards sb 是對某人的耐心。beyond patience 是無法忍受。

words.example: Try to persuade him to stay overnight.
words.notes: persuade sb to do 是說服某人做。persuade into 與 out of 也可搭配。

words.example: They prescribe rest and fluids.
words.exampleZh: 他們開的是休息和補水。
words.notes: prescribe a medicine 是開一種藥。也可表示規定。

words.example: A psychologist will visit this afternoon.
words.notes: clinical psychologist 是臨床心理師。也可指心理學家。

words.example: Most children recover in a week.
words.notes: 人作主詞是恢復健康。物作主詞、用被動時是被找回。

words.example: Recovery includes short walks each day.
words.notes: complete recovery 是完全康復。quick recovery 是迅速康復。

words.example: The lounge is a refuge from the noise.
words.exampleZh: 交誼廳是避開吵鬧的避難所。
words.notes: seek refuge 是尋求庇護。take refuge in 是在某處避難。

words.example: Please register at the front desk.
words.notes: 也可表示登記或註冊。register for 是報名某事。

words.example: Registration opens at seven.
words.notes: online registration 是線上掛號。registration office 是掛號處。

words.example: They spend the night in a chair.
words.notes: 過去式 spent 不規則。spend time on 是把時間花在。也可表示度過。

words.example: The transfusion started at noon.
words.notes: blood transfusion 是輸血。transfusion apparatus 是輸血器。也可指滲透。

words.example: This rash is treatable with a cream.
words.exampleZh: 這個疹子用藥膏就可治。
words.notes: medicable 與 curable 近義。

words.example: The clinic will vaccinate the class.
words.exampleZh: 診所會為這個班級施打疫苗。
words.notes: vaccine 是疫苗。inoculate 是作預防注射。

words.example: The vaccination is free for children.
words.exampleZh: 兒童疫苗接種是免費的。
words.notes: vaccination times 是接種次數。smallpox vaccination 是天花疫苗。

words.example: The ward has twenty beds.
words.notes: surgical ward 是外科病房。maternity ward 是產科病房。也可指監視。

words.example: The wheelchair is by the door.
words.notes: electric wheelchair 是電動輪椅。robotic wheelchair 是智能輪椅。
